title: Story premise ENT055: The One-Cell Traffic Jam
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Nobody can pass. One space can travel. Takeaway/theme: Moving the empty space can move the whole arrangement.
description: Three labeled tiles A, B, C occupy slots 1, 2, 3 on a four-position ring with slot 4 empty. A caretaker must move A to slot 2 while retaining clockwise tile order; C slides to 4, B to 3, and A to 2, leaving the vacancy at slot 1 without any tile passing another.
